title: Herb Crunchy Italian Chicken Pilaf
description: A nutty and crunchy Italian dish featuring rice wine and dry-brined chicken, perfect for meal prep and anti-inflammatory diets, served on a slate tile vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together rice wine, olive oil, thyme, rosemary, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat, then let it dry-brine for 30 minutes.
In a large saucepan, bring the chicken broth to a boil.
Add the uncooked rice to the saucepan, cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 18 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, spread the toasted pine nuts on a baking sheet and bake for 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and bake on a slate tile vessel in the oven for 20 minutes.
Fluff the cooked rice with a fork and stir in the toasted pine nuts.
Serve the chicken on top of the rice pilaf.
Garnish with fresh herbs if desired.
